vue-components.name: Pagination
vue-components.description: Headless, WAI-ARIA accessible pagination control — a windowed page-item model (numbers + ellipses), prev/next bounds, roving keyboard navigation, scoped slots, and a two-way `modelValue` page binding.

props.name: model-value
props.description: The 1-based current page (two-way model). Clamped into `[1, totalPages]`. Bind it with `r-model:modelValue` / `v-model:modelValue` / `modelValue` + `onModelValueChange`; it is also the Angular ControlValueAccessor control value.

props.name: total-pages
props.description: Explicit total page count. When provided (> 0) it takes precedence over `total` + `pageSize`. Use it when the backend already reports the page count.

props.name: total
props.description: Total item count. Combined with `pageSize` to derive the page count (`ceil(total / pageSize)`) when `totalPages` is not given.

props.name: page-size
props.description: Items per page. Combined with `total` to derive the page count when `totalPages` is not given.

props.name: sibling-count
props.description: Number of page buttons shown on each side of the current page (the sibling window). Larger values show more context around the current page.

props.name: boundary-count
props.description: Number of page buttons always shown at each boundary (the first and last `boundaryCount` pages), regardless of the current page.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable the entire control — every page button and the prev/next controls become non-interactive and are marked `aria-disabled`.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the surrounding `<nav>` landmark (its `aria-label`). Defaults to `"Pagination"`.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired whenever the current page changes (a page button, prev/next, or a programmatic `goto`/`next`/`prev`/`first`/`last`). Payload `{ page }` — the new clamped 1-based page. Not fired when the target page equals the current page.

events.name: update:modelValue
events.description: Emitted with the updated `modelValue` value; powers `v-model:modelValue`.

slots.name: prevControl
slots.type: { disabled: any; goto: any; page: any }

slots.name: item
slots.type: { page: any; selected: any; goto: any }

slots.name: nextControl
slots.type: { disabled: any; goto: any; page: any }
